cc:Work.dc:description: R0033, close_f_to_c. Both methods have an established follower relationship and the same speed and acceleration bounds. ACC sampled settling 858.2 s; AKS 148.5 s. ACC tracks the instantaneous policy spacing; KS2 tracks a planned trajectory to the same final equilibrium. Gains are unchanged and uncalibrated. No capacity or general safety claim.

g.text: F → C: restore the compact gap
R0033 · leader 50 m/s · both controllers under the same 30–80 m/s envelope and −2/+1.5 m/s² bounds
Sampled settling: baseline 858.2 s, reference 148.5 s — the reference is 5.8× faster.
Same settling criterion for both: |gap error| ≤ 1 m and |speed error| ≤ 0.05 m/s, held for the rest of the trace.
Final gap error: baseline +0.001 m, reference +0.000 m. dt = 0.03125 s. Uncalibrated declared gains; two aircraft; no capacity claim.
